title: IDF Strike Kills Hamas Operative Hassam Nasir and 3-Year-Old Boy in Deir al-Balah
detail: An Israeli strike in Deir al-Balah on Sunday, August 30, 2026 killed Hassam Osama Hussein Nasir, whom the military said was 'advancing attacks on troops and Israeli civilians.' Gaza health officials said a 3-year-old boy, Tayyem Hamdan, was also killed in the strike, with several others wounded. The strike came amid the fragile ceasefire that has held since October 2025; Israel's military has killed at least 1,313 Palestinians since it took effect, according to Gaza's Health Ministry.

media.caption: An air strike targets a commander in Hamas's Nukhba Force, in the Gaza Strip, August 30, 2026

title: IDF Says It Killed Hamas Nukhba Commander Mazloum and Sniper Deiri in Northern Gaza
detail: The IDF announced on Sunday, August 30, 2026 that it had killed Hani Abd al-Hai Fakhri Mazloum, described as a Hamas Nukhba Force company commander, and Hassan Zidan Hassan Deiri, described as a sniper, in northern Gaza. The military said both were 'trafficking and supplying weapons to Hamas terrorists' and had 'continued advancing attacks against Israeli troops and civilians and working to rebuild Hamas capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire.' IDF Southern Command forces conducted the strike using 'precise munitions and aerial surveillance' to minimize civilian harm, the military said. Hamas had not commented on the identifications at the time of reporting.

media.caption: IDF says it killed a Hamas Nukhba commander and sniper in northern Gaza, Aug 30, 2026
